description: Source code defining Android-related dispatchers and utilities for Playwright's server, including Android device management, input simulation, and socket communication.

classes.name: AndroidDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for Android objects, manages device enumeration.

classes.name: AndroidDeviceDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for individual Android devices, handles device interactions and input simulation.

classes.name: SocketSdkObject
classes.description: SdkObject wrapper for socket backend, manages data transmission and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: AndroidSocketDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for Android socket communication, handles data writing and connection closing.

methods.name: devices
methods.description: Retrieves list of Android devices connected.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a specified condition on the device.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Performs fill action on a device element.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a device element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the device.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the device.

methods.name: connectToWebView
methods.description: Connects to a WebView on the device.
